title: K-ON! Season 2: Plan!
synopsis: A special episode of K-ON!! released in the ninth volume of Blu-ray and DVD. The girls plan a trip abroad and go to the passport office to apply for passports.

episodes.synopsis: With the stress of final exams looming ahead, the girls decide a vacation abroad will be the perfect reward for all of their hard work.
